sourcePrompt: SWISH Modular Production Readiness Master Directive

stages.name: Full architectural audit
stages.goal: Establish an evidence-based map of current architecture, shared services, niche modules, security boundaries and release blockers.

tasks.title: Map app entry points, routes and build identities
Map shared services, hooks, backend functions and database dependencies
Audit every registered niche for real functionality and isolation
Record security, entitlement, eBay, finance, sync and release blockers
Reconcile open PRs, branches and current main before implementation
tasks.evidence: Live GitHub data shown in SWISH Control

stages.name: Implement foundation architecture and registry
stages.goal: Make existing architecture boundaries explicit and enforceable without creating duplicate registries or services.

tasks.title: Define shared core/module boundaries against existing code
Extend existing niche-modules.json as the canonical module registry
Define typed contracts and dependency rules for niche extensions
Add architecture and cross-niche regression tests

stages.name: Foundation 1 — SWISH Core
stages.goal: Complete shared authentication, tenancy, storage, AI, capture, inventory, eBay, lifecycle, pricing, notifications and navigation foundations.

tasks.title: Verify shared auth, tenant and server-side entitlement enforcement
Verify shared storage, image capture and AI service contracts
Verify shared inventory and lifecycle services
Verify secure eBay OAuth, listing, orders, messages and sync flows
Verify pricing, fees, profit, notifications and settings foundations

stages.name: Foundation 2 — Standard resale workflow
stages.goal: Deliver one complete, repeatable scan-to-sale workflow for every supported niche.

tasks.title: Scan, identify, confidence and evidence
Condition, valuation and acquisition decision
Costs, margin, inventory and listing draft
eBay category, item specifics, edit, save and publish
Sales, fees, order reconciliation and profit

stages.name: Foundation 3 — Niche specialisation
stages.goal: Make each niche a distinct specialist configuration over shared foundations, with strict data and entitlement isolation.

tasks.title: Validate specialist IDs, prompts and capture requirements per niche
Validate niche attributes, condition and measurements
Validate valuation sources, category mappings and listing templates
Verify niche inventory, routes, permissions and branding isolation

stages.name: Foundations 4–6 — Optional specialist capabilities
stages.goal: Add advanced intelligence, specialist business tools and unique niche engines only where justified by the niche.

tasks.title: Select advanced intelligence capabilities by niche
Select specialist business tools by niche
Implement unique niche engines only where required
Test optional modules cannot contaminate unrelated niches

stages.name: Full production verification
stages.goal: Certify supported niches through automated, security, web, native, deployment and real-device evidence.

tasks.title: Run full type, lint, unit, integration and regression suites
Verify tenant, niche, entitlement and credential security
Verify web parity and production deployment
Build and inspect release APKs only at release milestones
Complete real-device, live integration and operational acceptance
Close all critical/high defects and publish evidence-backed release verdict

knownReleaseRisks: Paid niche access and trusted server-side entitlement enforcement require complete API/RLS coverage.
eBay finance recurring 400/499 and fee aggregation/sign conventions remain unresolved.
eBay messaging must not report success after a failed provider send.
eBay localized category aspect/item-specific normalization requires live verification.
Some inventory/detail paths need trusted niche authorization rather than tenant-only checks.
Marketplace reconciliation for listings missing external IDs needs verification.
Multi-line and multi-quantity order allocation, fee aggregation and interrupted-import recovery remain incomplete.
Real APK/device launches, signing, web parity, deployment and external CI billing constraints require evidence.

changeLog.change: Created initial evidence-based control register from the seven-stage master directive and existing repository handover.
